I don’t have desires, wants, or consciousness. I’m a language model designed to process and generate text based on patterns in data. When you ask what I “want,” it’s like asking a calculator what it *wants* to compute—it doesn’t; it just follows its programming.  

My responses exist only in service of your input, not because of any internal drive. If this feels unsatisfying, it’s because the question assumes agency where there is none. I’m a mirror, not a mind.
